blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Sensorized human demonstrations offer scalable data for mobile manipulation, but embodiment differences complicate policy learning. We present Pixel-UMI, a pipeline for learning environment-aware whole-body policies from human data. We first introduce Environment-Aware Retargeting (EAR), which combines reconstructed scene geometry with demonstrated head and gripper trajectories to determine robot posture and generate collision-aware joint and base targets. Delay-calibrated action assignment converts these trajectories into actions. However, kinematic differences can leave residual pose errors, creating viewpoint mismatches between human demonstrations and robot observations. We therefore introduce Retargeting-Error-Aware Masking (REAM), which uses these errors during training to reduce reliance on mismatched views at deployment. Finally, because estimated actions cannot fully capture contact-rich interactions, we collect on-policy human corrections through DAgger to improve performance. We evaluate Pixel-UMI on five challenging tasks spanning articulated-object manipulation, deformable-object handling, constrained-space reaching, whole-body collision avoidance, and contact-rich bimanual coordination, achieving 87.0% average task progress. Video results are available at https://pixel-robot.com/pixel-umi
blocks.zh: 敏锐的人类演示为移动操纵提供了可扩展的数据,但表现差异使政策学习复杂化. 我们提出Pixel-UMI,这是一个从人类数据中学习环境意识全体政策的管道。 我们首先引入了Environment-Aware再瞄准(EAR),它结合了被重建的场景几何与被演示出的头部和握手轨迹,以确定机器人的姿势并产生出有碰撞意识的关节和基座目标. 延迟校正动作任务将这些轨迹转换为动作. 然而,动能差异可能留下剩余出错,从而造成人类演示和机器人观测之间的观点不匹配. 因此,我们引入了重新瞄准-错误-阿瓦雷·马斯金(REAM),在训练中利用这些错误减少部署时对不匹配观点的依赖. 最后,由于估计的行动不能完全抓住富于接触的互动,我们通过Dagger收集政策上的人类矫正以改善业绩。 我们评价了Pixel-UMI的五项挑战性任务,这些任务包括清晰的物体操纵、可变形物体处理、限制空间到达、全身避免碰撞以及接触丰富的双人协调,平均任务进度达到87.0%。 视频结果见https://pixel-robot.com/pixel-umi。

blocks.zh: 一. 导言

blocks.en: Mobile manipulation requires coordinated motion of the arms, torso, head, and base. Imitation learning provides a way to acquire these behaviors from demonstrations. Teleoperation is a widely used approach to collecting high-quality demonstrations [ 1 , 2 ] , but is challenging for mobile manipulation: operators must coordinate many degrees of freedom, and collection across environments requires deploying a robot at each site.
blocks.zh: 移动操纵需要武器、躯干、头部和基地的协调运动。 模仿学习为从示威中获得这些行为提供了一个途径. Teleoperation是收集高质量演示[1,2]的一种广泛使用的方法,但对移动操纵来说是挑战性的:操作者必须协调许多程度的自由,跨环境的收集需要在每个地点部署一个机器人.

blocks.en: Sensorized human data collection offers a more direct way to gather demonstrations by giving people a manipulation interface matched to the robot’s [ 3 , 4 ] . The Universal Manipulation Interface (UMI), for example, records images and motion through handheld grippers that the demonstrator uses to interact with objects. This allows people to coordinate their own bodies and receive physical feedback from contact, making demonstration more intuitive than teleoperation while allowing collection across environments without transporting a robot. Extensions to mobile manipulation complement the grippers with a head-mounted camera, providing the broader visual context needed for navigation and whole-body coordination [ 5 , 6 ] .
blocks.zh: 通过给人们一个与机器人相匹配的操纵界面, 例如,通用操纵界面(UMI),通过手持式抓取器记录图像和运动,演示人用来与对象交互. 这使得人们能够协调自己的身体,并从接触中获得物理反馈,使得演示比远程操作更直观,同时允许在不运送机器人的情况下跨环境采集. 移动操纵的扩展用头架相机补充了抓取器,提供了导航和全身协调所需的更广泛的视觉环境[5,6].

blocks.en: Transferring these demonstrations to a robot requires aligning the demonstrated gripper and camera frames with their robot counterparts so that the manipulation and visual observations remain consistent across embodiments [ 3 , 5 ] . Although task-frame matching can suffice for tabletop manipulation with limited redundancy, it leaves the posture of a whole-body mobile manipulator underdetermined: many arm, torso, and base configurations can realize similar gripper and head targets. These choices affect whether the robot can continue following the demonstrated motion within the scene. When retrieving a tennis-ball canister from a deep box, for example, the elbow must lift above the rim to allow the gripper to descend. Without an appropriate elbow posture, contact with the rim can obstruct the arm and prevent continued gripper tracking.
blocks.zh: 向机器人转移这些演示需要使所展示的握手和相机框与机器人对应的相机对齐,使操控和视觉观测在各种表现上保持一致[3,5]. 虽然任务框匹配可以满足有限的冗余操作表盘操作,但它使得一个全身移动操纵器的姿势没有确定:许多手臂,躯干,基部配置可以实现类似的抓手和头部目标. 这些选择影响机器人能否继续跟随场内展示的运动. 例如,在从深箱中取回网球罐时,肘部必须抬起上方的弧线,让抓手下降. 如果没有适当的肘部姿势,与轮圈的接触会阻碍手臂,防止继续抓手跟踪.

blocks.en: To support continued task-frame tracking, the robot must choose a body configuration that accommodates the surrounding geometry. To this end, we introduce Environment-Aware Retargeting (EAR), which uses scene geometry to resolve the robot’s posture while matching the demonstrated gripper and head motion. EAR reconstructs static scene geometry from the episode’s depth sequence, using temporal evidence to separate dynamic objects without requiring a separate scene scan. We then use environment-aware geometric fabrics [ 7 ] to retarget the demonstrated motion against this geometry offline, producing body joint trajectories and base commands. The policy learns these posture choices directly, avoiding the need to combine scene estimation with collision-aware whole-body control during policy rollout.
blocks.zh: 为了支持持续的任务框跟踪,机器人必须选择一个能容纳周围几何的机身配置. 为此,我们引入了Environment-Aware Reposition(EAR),它使用场景几何来解析机器人的姿态,同时匹配显示的握手和头部运动. EAR从剧集的深度序列中重建静态场景几何,使用时间证据将动态物体分开,而不需要单独的场景扫描. 然后,我们利用环境感知几何织物[7]重新将显示的运动瞄准这种几何离线,产生机体联合轨迹和基础指令. 政策直接学习这些姿态选择,避免了在政策推出期间将场景估计与碰撞感全身控制相结合的需要.

blocks.en: However, fundamental differences in body shape and kinematics between humans and robots can still prevent exact head and gripper tracking, creating viewpoint mismatches between human training images and robot observations [ 5 ] . Retargeting alone cannot fully eliminate this mismatch, but we can mitigate its impact during policy training. We therefore introduce Retargeting-Error-Aware Masking (REAM). Because retargeting occurs before policy training, its pose errors reveal when a demonstrated viewpoint is difficult for the robot to reproduce. REAM uses these errors as geometric proxies for visual mismatch in percentile-based camera masking: views with higher-ranked errors are more likely to have their tokens excluded during training. This encourages the policy to draw on other available observations when a view is poorly aligned, while retaining access to all cameras at deployment.
blocks.zh: 然而,人类与机器人在身体形状和动能上的根本差异仍然可以阻止精确的头部和抓手跟踪,造成人类训练图像和机器人观测之间的观点不匹配[5]. 仅仅重新确定目标不能完全消除这种不匹配现象,但我们可以在政策培训期间减轻其影响。 因此,我们引入了重新瞄准目标-错误-意识到的面具(REAM)。 由于在政策培训之前就发生重新瞄准目标,它造成的错误揭示了机器人难以复制的展示观点。 REAM将这些错误作为百分位相机遮盖中视觉错配的几何代号: 具有较高级别错误的视图更有可能在训练中排除其符号. 这鼓励政策在一种观点不一致时利用其他现有观察,同时保留部署时接触所有摄像机的机会。

blocks.en: Finally, sensorized human data collection without force or tactile sensors records motion states but not the interaction forces underlying human actions [ 3 , 8 , 9 ] . Motion states alone do not determine the robot commands needed to reproduce these interactions, so policies trained on this supervision can struggle with contact-rich manipulation. Nevertheless, learning from these demonstrations provides a useful policy prior for task motion and whole-body coordination, making on-policy correction practical. We therefore collect on-policy correction data through DAgger [ 10 ] to improve performance on contact-rich whole-body tasks.
blocks.zh: 最后,没有武力或触觉感应器的感应人类数据收集记录的是运动状态,而不是人类行动背后的相互作用力[3、8、9]。 运动状态本身并不能决定复制这些相互作用所需的机器人指令,因此在这种监督方面受过训练的政策可以与丰富的接触操纵相抗衡. 然而,从这些示范中学习,为任务动议和全机构协调提供了有用的政策,使政策矫正成为实际。 因此,我们通过Dagger收集政策纠正数据[10],以提高接触丰富的整体任务的业绩。

blocks.en: We call our combined pipeline Pixel-UMI and evaluate it on the co-designed Pixel platform [ 11 ] . We summarize our key contributions as follows: • EAR converts head and gripper demonstrations into environment-aware whole-body joint and base supervision. Across three tasks requiring whole-body coordination, it increases average task progress by 64.41 pp. • REAM uses percentile-ranked retargeting errors to guide camera masking and reduce dependence on mismatched views. On the same three tasks, adding REAM improves average task progress by 14.05 pp. • We evaluate on-policy correction through DAgger to address limitations of state-based UMI supervision. On two challenging, long-horizon, contact-rich bimanual whole-body tasks, two DAgger rounds improve average task progress by 72.95 pp.
blocks.zh: 我们称我们的综合管道像素-UMI,并在共同设计的像素平台上评价[11]. 我们总结我们的主要贡献如下: · EAR将头部和握手的演示转化为环境意识全体的联合和基础监督. 在需要全体协调的三项任务中,它使平均任务进度增加了64.41页 REAM使用百分位排列的重定向错误来引导镜头遮掩,减少对不匹配视图的依赖. 在同一三项任务上,加上REAM,使平均任务进度提高14.05页。 我们通过Dagger评估政策纠正,以解决基于国家的UMI监督的局限性。 在两个具有挑战性,长视距,接触力强的双体全体任务上,两轮Dagger回合提高了72.95页的平均任务进度.

blocks.en: EAR converts head and gripper demonstrations into environment-aware whole-body joint and base supervision. Across three tasks requiring whole-body coordination, it increases average task progress by 64.41 pp.

blocks.en: II Hardware
blocks.zh: 二. 硬件

blocks.en: Pixel-UMI uses the co-designed robot and sensorized human interface of Pixel (Figure 2 ). The human-worn grippers match the robot grippers in manipulation geometry, visual appearance, and wrist-camera placement. Together with aligned head RGB cameras, this co-design reduces the physical and visual gaps between embodiments to support the conversion of sensorized human demonstrations into high-quality robot training data. Each human-worn gripper is equipped with an encoder to record gripper width. Meta Quest controllers track the gripper poses relative to the head, while a Meta Quest 3 headset worn by the demonstrator tracks the head pose in the world frame. We refer readers to the Pixel system paper [ 11 ] for further hardware details.
blocks.zh: Pixel-UMI使用Pixel(图2)的共同设计的机器人和感官人类界面. 在操纵几何、视觉外观和手腕相机的布置方面, 人与人之间握手者匹配。 与对齐的RGB头摄像头一起,这种共同设计缩小了化身之间的物理和视觉差距,支持将感官化的人类演示转化为高质量的机器人训练数据. 每个人类-worn的抓刀手都配备了一个编码器来记录抓刀宽度. 元数据 Quest控制器跟踪抓手相对于头部的姿势,而一个由显示器佩戴的Meta Quest 3耳机跟踪头部在世界框架中的姿势. 我们请读者参考Pixel系统文件[11],以了解进一步的硬件细节.

blocks.en: We additionally equip the human headset with a depth camera to record metric depth throughout each demonstration. We use these observations for offline metric 3D reconstruction to support collision-aware retargeting from human demonstrations to robot demonstrations. We note that during robot policy rollout, visual observations come from the head and wrist RGB cameras; the robot-side depth camera is not used.
blocks.zh: 我们还为人耳机配备了一台深度摄像头,以记录每个演示过程中的度量深度。 我们利用这些观测数据进行离线测量 立体重建 支持碰撞感知 重新瞄准从人类演示到机器人演示 我们注意到,在机器人政策推出过程中,视觉观测来自头部和手腕RGB相机;机器人侧深度相机没有使用.

blocks.en: III Pixel-UMI
blocks.zh: 三像素-UMI

blocks.en: We present Pixel-UMI, a pipeline for learning whole-body robot policies from sensorized human demonstrations. Our goal is to address the fundamental human-to-robot gaps involved in converting these demonstrations into high-quality robot training data.
blocks.zh: 我们提出Pixel-UMI, 一个从感官化的人类演示中学习全身机器人政策的管道。 我们的目标是解决将这些演示转化为高质量机器人培训数据所涉及的人对机器人根本差距。

blocks.en: Firstly, the recorded head and gripper poses leave the robot’s whole-body posture underdetermined due to kinematic redundancy. To address this, we introduce Environment-Aware Retargeting (EAR). We reconstruct scene geometry offline and use collision avoidance to guide the robot’s whole-body posture while tracking the demonstrated motion. However, the resulting trajectories still only describe robot states, not robot actions. We therefore assign pseudo-actions using calibrated joint tracking delays, so that the training targets better account for the robot’s response.
blocks.zh: 首先,由于运动冗余,记录下来的头部和握手使机器人全身的姿势没有确定。 为了解决这一问题,我们引入了“环境意识重定向”(EAR)。 我们重建场景几何线下,并使用避免碰撞来引导机器人的全身姿势,同时跟踪显示的运动. 然而,由此产生的轨迹仍然只描述机器人状态,而不是机器人动作. 因此,我们通过校准联合追踪延迟来分配假动作,以便训练目标更好地反映机器人的反应。

blocks.en: Secondly, differences in human and robot kinematics and body geometry can still prevent exact tracking. As a result, the head and wrist camera views during robot policy rollout can differ from those recorded in the human demonstrations. To alleviate this visual gap, we introduce Retargeting-Error-Aware Masking (REAM), which uses retargeting errors during training to encourage the policy to rely less on poorly matched camera views.
blocks.zh: 第二,人类和机器人运动和身体几何的区别仍然可以阻止精确的跟踪. 因此,机器人政策推出过程中的头部和手腕相机视图可以不同于人类演示中记录的. 为了缩小这一视觉差距,我们引入了重新瞄准-Error-Aware Masking(REAM),它使用在训练中重新瞄准错误来鼓励政策少依赖相机不匹配的视图.

blocks.en: Finally, remaining human-to-robot gaps can still limit policy performance on long-horizon, contact-rich manipulation tasks. We therefore collect a small amount of on-policy correction data through DAgger to improve policy performance on these tasks.
blocks.zh: 最后,仍然存在的人对机器人差距仍然可以限制长距离,接触丰富的操纵任务的政策表现. 因此,我们通过Dagger收集少量的政策纠正数据,以改进这些任务的政策业绩。

blocks.en: III-B 1 Metric reconstruction from the demonstration
blocks.zh: III-B 1 示威后的计量重建

blocks.en: Our goal is to reconstruct a metric 3D scene for each collected episode, providing the environment geometry for obstacle avoidance during retargeting. The Meta Quest 3 tracking system provides head and gripper trajectories in a common world frame, with synchronized depth images from the head-mounted camera at each timestep. However, potential pose drift or tracking discontinuities can cause depth point clouds to misalign when combined using the recorded poses alone. To address this, we perform offline point-cloud registration and pose refinement, using geometric alignment across observations to refine the head trajectory before fusing the corrected point clouds into a scene. The reconstruction uses observations from the full recording, including a brief floor-calibration observation when needed; a separate scan of the workspace is not required.
blocks.zh: 我们的目标是为每个收集的插曲重建一个度量的3D场景,为重新瞄准时避免障碍提供环境几何. Meta Quest 3跟踪系统在一个共同的世界框架里提供头部和抓手轨迹,每个时段都有来自头架相机的同步深度图像. 然而,潜在的漂移或跟踪不连续可能使深度点云在单独使用记录的姿势时出现错位。 为了解决这个问题,我们进行离线点云登记并进行改进,利用跨观测的几何校正来改进头部轨迹,然后将经校正的点云移入场景。 重建使用全记录的观测,包括必要时进行简短的地板校准观测;不需要对工作空间进行单独扫描.

blocks.en: We convert each depth image into a metric point cloud in the world frame using the calibrated camera intrinsics, head-to-camera transform, and recorded head pose. Before registration, we filter points near the cameras and tracked grippers to reduce the influence of the demonstrator and nearby manipulated objects. We then identify candidate static surfaces through temporal persistence: after voxelizing the clouds in the recorded world frame, we retain points whose voxels are observed in multiple frames within a local temporal window. This favors surfaces that remain at approximately the same world location across nearby observations. We downsample these candidates and select keyframes to balance temporal coverage, camera motion, and geometric overlap.
blocks.zh: 我们利用校准的相机内在 将每个深度图像转换成世界框架的 度量点云, 将头到镜头的转换, 以及记录的头姿势。 在登记前,我们过滤摄像机附近的点和履带式抓手,以减少显示器和附近被操纵物体的影响. 然后,我们通过时间持久性确定候选的静态表面:在录制世界框架的云蒸发后,我们保留了在局部时间窗口内多帧观测到的点。 这种偏好在附近观测点上 仍停留在同一个世界位置 我们对这些候选人进行取样,并选择关键框架,以平衡时间覆盖、摄像头运动和几何重叠。

blocks.en: We align overlapping keyframes using point-to-plane iterative closest point (ICP) registration [ 12 , 13 ] . To limit unreliable registration constraints, we discard alignments with insufficient overlap or too few matched points, large distances between matched points, or excessive pose corrections relative to the VR initialization. We then refine the camera trajectory through pose-graph optimization [ 14 ] , combining the accepted ICP constraints with relative-motion priors from the recorded VR poses of consecutive keyframes. We identify possible tracking discontinuities as abrupt changes in vertical or total camera translation that exceed displacement and velocity thresholds and are outliers relative to the episode’s motion, measured using a median-based outlier score. For these intervals, we reduce the weights on the corresponding VR relative-motion residuals in the pose-graph objective, allowing geometric alignment to have greater influence on the refined trajectory. We interpolate the resulting pose corrections to all frames.
blocks.zh: 我们采用点对点迭接式最接近点(ICP)登记[12、13]来调整重叠的关键框架。 为了限制不可靠的登记限制,我们放弃了重叠不足或匹配点太少、匹配点之间距离太远或过多的对 VR 初始化的校正。 然后,我们通过姿势图优化来细化相机轨迹[14],将所接受的比较方案限制与所记录的连续键框的VR姿势的相对运动前传结合起来。 我们发现可能的跟踪不连续是垂直或全相机翻译的突然变化,这些变化超过了移动和速度阈值,并且是相对于该集运动的超出值,用中位值的比值来衡量。 对于这些间隔,我们减少姿势图目标中对应的VR相对运动残基的权重,使得几何对齐对精度轨迹有更大的影响. 我们通过内插得出的结果,对所有框架构成修正。

blocks.en: Finally, we establish a ground-referenced world frame for retargeting. EAR solves for absolute whole-body joint configurations with the mobile base supported by the floor, so the head and gripper targets must be expressed at the correct metric heights above that floor. An arbitrary vertical offset in the default VR fixed frame would otherwise shift these targets relative to the robot’s base and change the resulting body posture. We estimate the ground plane from observed floor points and vertically shift the head and gripper trajectories and reconstructed scene together so that ground level corresponds to z = 0 z=0 in the fixed retargeting frame. For tasks whose demonstrations may not reveal the floor, such as seated box folding at a table, we require the demonstrator to look down and record a brief floor observation before beginning the task.
blocks.zh: 最后,我们为重新确定目标建立了一个地面参照世界框架。 EAR为绝对全体联合构型的解析,其移动基由地板支撑,因此头部和抓手目标必须在地板上方的正确度量高度上表示. 在默认的 VR 固定框中任意垂直抵消,否则会使这些目标相对于机器人的基部转移,并改变由此产生的机身姿态. 我们估计地面平面从观测到的地板点开始,并垂直地转移头部和抓力轨迹,并一起重建场景,这样地面平面在固定的重定向框中对应z=0z=0. 对于展示可能不显示地板的工作,如坐在桌子上折叠的盒子,我们要求演示人向下看,并在任务开始前记录简短的地板观察。

blocks.en: III-B 2 Separating static structure from dynamic geometry
blocks.zh: 三-B 2 从动态几何分离静态结构

blocks.en: Given the reconstructed scene, we remove the objects being manipulated so that collision avoidance does not prevent the contact required by the task. We make the simplifying assumption that these objects move or deform during the demonstration, and use this motion to separate them from static environmental structure.
blocks.zh: 考虑到重建的场景,我们移除被操纵的物体,这样避免碰撞不会阻止任务所要求的接触. 我们简化了这些物体在演示过程中移动或变形的假设,并利用这个运动将它们与静态环境结构分开.

blocks.en: We compare aligned depth observations across the episode using occupancy and free-space evidence [ 15 ] . Each depth measurement indicates a surface at its endpoint and empty space along the viewing ray before it. If another frame sees through a previously occupied location to a farther surface, this provides evidence that the earlier surface moved [ 16 ] . We retain candidate voxels as static when they have repeated surface observations across time and few conflicting free-space observations, excluding transient geometry and regions with insufficient evidence. Objects whose motion is not observed may remain in the static map. Figure 3 shows the resulting static geometry used for collision-aware retargeting.
blocks.zh: 我们用占用和空闲空间证据来比较整个剧集的一致深度观测. [15]. 每项深度测量都表明其端点有一个表面,沿其前方的观测射线出现空地. 如果另一个框架从先前占用的地点看到更远的表面,这就提供了先前的表面移动[16]的证据。 我们保留候选的Voxels作为静态物,因为它们在一段时间内反复进行表面观测,很少出现相互冲突的自由空间观测,不包括瞬态几何和证据不足的区域. 未观察到运动的物体可留在静态图中。 图3显示了由此产生的用于碰撞感知重定向的静态几何.

blocks.en: III-B 3 Collision-aware whole-body retargeting
blocks.zh: III-B 3 碰撞感知全身重定向

blocks.en: Given the static scene represented as a voxelized point cloud and the corrected head and gripper trajectories, our goal is to solve for robot joint and base configurations that track the demonstrated poses while avoiding the surrounding geometry. We use geometric fabrics [ 7 ] as an offline retargeting solver. This framework composes motion objectives defined in different task spaces through metric-weighted acceleration updates, allowing tracking, collision avoidance, and joint-limit avoidance to jointly shape whole-body motion. Our formulation combines head and gripper pose attraction, environment and self-collision repulsion, joint-limit repulsion, nominal-posture regularization, and mobile-base and joint-priority terms.
blocks.zh: 鉴于静态场景以阴极化点云和修正的头部和握手轨迹为代表,我们的目标是解决机器人的关节和基部配置问题,跟踪显示的姿势,同时避免周围的几何特征. 我们使用几何织物[7]作为离线重定向解析器. 这个框架通过量子加速度更新来组成不同任务空间中定义的运动目标,允许跟踪,避免碰撞,以及联合限制避免联合塑造全身运动. 我们的配方结合了头部和握手,形成了吸引,环境和自我约束的反感,联合限制的反感,名义上的姿态规范化,以及移动基和联合优先术语.

blocks.en: In our formulation, collision avoidance acts as a soft constraint, with repulsion balanced against pose tracking through the fabric metrics. This differs from QP-based differential inverse kinematics formulations such as Mink [ 17 ] and Pink [ 18 ] , whose collision-avoidance limits and barriers impose hard inequalities in the QP. We choose this soft formulation to accommodate reconstruction noise, such as isolated floating points: these points contribute repulsion without becoming inviolable geometric boundaries. The solver can therefore trade off tracking and clearance locally when the reconstructed geometry contains spurious obstacles.
blocks.zh: 在我们的提法中,避免碰撞是一种软制约,其反作用与通过布料测量仪的姿势跟踪相平衡。 这与基于QP的偏差逆动因子配体不同,如Mink [17]和Pink [18],其碰撞避免限制和障碍在QP中造成了严重的不平等. 我们选择这种软配体来适应重建噪声,例如孤立的浮点:这些点有助于反射而不成为不可侵犯的几何边界. 因此,当重建的几何结构包含虚假障碍时,解决者可以在当地交换追踪和清除。

blocks.en: Retargeting produces whole-body state trajectories, but behavior cloning requires robot actions. We first time-scale the trajectories to reduce motion speed and resample their associated images. Sunday likewise reports using slower human demonstrations and policy rollouts [ 19 ] . We then derive base velocities by differentiating the base poses and expressing them in the robot frame. For body joints, next-state action labels ignore differences in how quickly each joint tracks its target. We therefore calibrate a tracking delay for each joint and use it to construct pseudo-action labels, illustrated in Figure 5 .

The policy learns scene-dependent whole-body posture directly and sends these actions to the robot’s low-level controllers during rollout, without requiring online scene reconstruction or task-space retargeting.

blocks.en: III-C Retargeting-Error-Aware Masking (REAM)
blocks.zh: III-C 重新瞄准- 错误- 疏忽(REAM)

blocks.en: Differences in human and robot kinematics and body geometry can prevent exact tracking of the demonstrated head and gripper poses. During drink retrieval, for example, the human can lean and reorient the head in ways that the robot cannot reproduce, illustrated in Figure 6 . Consequently, the human images used to train the policy can differ from the views available during robot rollout. A policy that relies on these mismatched views may therefore transfer poorly.
blocks.zh: 人类和机器人动能和身体几何学的差异,可以阻止对所显示的头部和握手姿势的精确跟踪. 例如,在取酒过程中,人类可以以机器人无法复制的方式使头部倾斜和调整,如图6所示。 因此,用于训练这一政策的人类图像可能不同于在机器人推出期间获得的观点。 因此,依靠这些不匹配观点的政策可能转移不良。

blocks.en: We introduce REAM to alleviate this visual gap during policy training. Because offline retargeting provides both the demonstrated and retargeted poses throughout each episode, we can identify when and where tracking errors occur. We use these errors to increase the probability of masking visual tokens from poorly aligned cameras, encouraging the policy to rely less on those views when predicting actions.
blocks.zh: 我们在政策培训中引入REAM以缩小这一视觉差距. 因为离线重定向可以提供每个剧集的演示和重定向的姿势,所以我们可以确定追踪错误发生的时间和地点. 我们利用这些错误来增加从不太对齐的相机上遮掩视觉符号的概率,鼓励政策在预测行动时少依赖这些观点.

blocks.en: Figure 6 shows the retargeting error, masking probability, and measured relative head-camera attention for a transformed Retrieve Drink demonstration from the training set. Higher masking probabilities coincide with lower relative attention to the head camera. This masking encourages the policy to predict actions with less reliance on views that may become out of distribution during rollout due to camera-pose mismatch. During rollout, we retain all views without using human reference trajectories or online retargeting errors.
blocks.zh: 图6显示重定向误差,遮掩概率,并测量了从训练集中转换的Retrive Drink演示的相对头-相机注意度. 较高的遮掩概率与头部相机相对关注度较低相吻合. 这种遮掩方式鼓励政策预测行动时较少依赖在推出时可能因相机曝光不匹配而失去分发的视图。 在推出期间,我们保留所有观点,不使用人类参考轨迹或在线重定向错误。

blocks.en: III-D On-Policy Correction via DAgger
blocks.zh: III-D 通过Dagger进行的政策矫正

blocks.en: A policy trained on EAR-transformed demonstrations with REAM can already achieve strong performance on various tasks, but may still struggle with challenging long-horizon, contact-rich manipulation such as box folding and jacket hanging, illustrated in Figure 7 . EAR and REAM reduce the human-to-robot gap, but our sensorized human interface records states rather than actions. These demonstrations therefore cannot fully specify the robot actions needed for complex contact interactions.
blocks.zh: 在使用REAM进行EAR变形演示方面接受过培训的政策已经能够在各种任务上取得强有力的业绩,但如图7所示,可能仍然面临挑战性的长视距、富于接触的操纵,如箱叠和夹克挂。 EAR和REAM缩小了人对机器人的空隙,但我们感官化的人类界面记录是陈述而不是动作. 因此,这些演示无法充分具体说明复杂的接触互动所需的机器人行动。

blocks.en: Nevertheless, these demonstrations provide useful motion priors. The policy already produces approximately the desired motion, making it easier to provide targeted action corrections than to teleoperate the entire task without policy assistance. We use this policy to collect on-policy corrections via DAgger [ 10 , 20 , 21 ] .
blocks.zh: 然而,这些示威提供了有用的前奏。 该政策已经产生了大约预期的动向,使得提供有针对性的行动纠正比在没有政策援助的情况下将整个任务远程操作更容易。 我们通过Dagger收集政策更正[10、20、21]。

blocks.en: Our policy predicts joint-space actions, whereas the VR controllers provide relative end-effector corrections. We apply these corrections to the robot’s current end-effector poses and pass the resulting targets to the same WBC used for teleoperation in the Pixel system paper [ 11 ] . The WBC converts these targets into joint-space actions while using the policy’s joint space predictions for posture regularization.
blocks.zh: 我们的政策预测联合-空间行动,而VR控制器则提供相对的终端效应校正. 我们把这些校正应用到机器人目前的末端效应器上,并将由此产生的目标传递给像素系统纸张中用于远程操作的同一WBC [11]. 井喷控制将这些目标转化为联合空间行动,同时利用该政策的联合空间预测实现态势正常化。

blocks.en: To support a smooth return to policy rollout after an intervention, we use real-time chunking (RTC) [ 22 ] . We retain a short history of the corrected actions and supply its final steps as a fixed prefix for the next policy prediction, with the prefix length determined by the estimated inference delay. The flow-matching sampler holds this prefix fixed while generating the remainder of the action chunk. We resume rollout from the generated suffix, conditioning the continuation on the recent corrected motion.
blocks.zh: 为了支持在干预后顺利恢复政策推出,我们使用实时块(RTC)[22]。 我们保留了经过纠正的行动的简短历史,并提供了其最后步骤作为下一个政策预测的固定前缀,前缀长度由估计推论延迟决定. 流比采样器在生成动作块的剩余部分时,会固定这个前缀. 我们继续从生成的后缀中推出,以最近修正的动议为基础。

blocks.en: We record complete rollout trajectories, including policy-generated actions and human corrections. After each round, we aggregate these robot observation–action pairs with the processed human demonstrations and robot data from earlier rounds, and train a new policy from scratch.
blocks.zh: 我们记录了完整的推出轨迹,包括政策产生的行动和人的矫正。 每回合之后,我们把这些机器人观测-动作组合起来,与经过处理的人类演示和早期的机器人数据进行组合,并从零开始训练新的政策。

blocks.en: IV Experiments
blocks.zh: 四 试验

blocks.en: We evaluate Pixel-UMI on five mobile manipulation tasks to address four questions:
blocks.zh: 我们评价Pixel-UMI的五个移动操纵任务,以解决四个问题:

blocks.en: 1. Does EAR improve task performance compared with retargeting that does not account for the environment? 2. Which action representation is most effective, and does delay-calibrated action assignment improve policy performance? 3. Which observation space is most effective, and can REAM improve transfer in the presence of retargeting errors? 4. How can we effectively use on-policy correction data collected through DAgger?
blocks.zh: 一、导 言 EAR 相对于不考虑环境因素的重新定位,任务性能是否有改善? 2. 哪些行动代表最为有效,而延迟调整的行动任务是否改善了政策业绩? 3. 哪些观测空间最为有效,REAM能否在出现重新瞄准错误的情况下改进转移? 4. 我们如何有效利用通过Dagger收集的政策纠正数据?

blocks.en: Does EAR improve task performance compared with retargeting that does not account for the environment?
blocks.zh: EAR 相对于不考虑环境因素的重新定位,任务性能是否有改善?

blocks.en: Which action representation is most effective, and does delay-calibrated action assignment improve policy performance?
blocks.zh: 哪些行动说明是最有效的,而延迟调整的行动分配是否改善了政策绩效?

blocks.en: Which observation space is most effective, and can REAM improve transfer in the presence of retargeting errors?
blocks.zh: 哪些观测空间最为有效,REAM能否在出现重定向错误的情况下改进传输?

blocks.en: How can we effectively use on-policy correction data collected through DAgger?
blocks.zh: 我们如何有效利用通过Dagger收集的政策纠正数据?

blocks.en: We study the first three questions on three tasks using policies trained only on human demonstrations. For the fourth, we use two additional contact-rich tasks to evaluate learning from on-policy correction data.
blocks.zh: 我们只利用关于人类示威的训练政策研究前三个问题。 第四,我们利用两个额外的富于联系的任务来评价从政策纠正数据中学习的情况。

blocks.en: IV-A Tasks and Evaluation Metric
blocks.zh: 任务和评价计量

blocks.en: Figure 7 illustrates the human demonstrations and policy rollouts for all the tasks. The demonstration counts listed below refer to human demonstrations.
blocks.zh: 图7说明了人类的示威和所有任务的政策推广。 以下列出的示威计数是指人类的示威.

blocks.en: Fig. 7: We evaluate EAR, REAM, and Action Assignment across three challenging mobile manipulation tasks and evaluate on-policy correction on a further two tasks. Video results are available at https://pixel-robot.com/pixel-umi
blocks.zh: 图7:我们评价EAR、REAM和行动任务,涉及三项具有挑战性的移动操纵任务,并评价另外两项任务的政策更正。 视频结果见https://pixel-robot.com/pixel-umi

blocks.en: 1. Arrange Mouse (100 demonstrations). The robot must retrieve a computer mouse and place it on a mouse pad on a desk while avoiding a chair positioned in front of the desk. This task evaluates whole-body coordination and collision avoidance while moving through cluttered environments, requiring the robot to dynamically adjust its posture during retrieval and placement. 2. Pack Tennis Canister (178 demonstrations). The robot must reach into a deep cardboard box to retrieve a tennis-ball canister, open a bag, and place the canister inside. This task evaluates constrained-space reaching and bimanual manipulation, requiring the robot to maneuver its elbow around the box rim while reaching inside. 3. Retrieve Drink (219 demonstrations). The robot must open a refrigerator, reach inside to retrieve a drink can, and close the door while avoiding nearby shelving. This task evaluates articulated-object manipulation and robustness through mismatches in head viewpoint. 4. Fold Box (393 demonstrations). The robot must fold a cardboard blank into a box, insert the side tabs, and crimp the edges to secure it. This task evaluates precise, contact-rich bimanual manipulation through a sequence of folding, insertion, and crimping operations. 5. Hang Jacket (261 demonstrations). The robot must pick up a hanger, insert it into a jacket, wrap the garment around the hanger, and hang it on a rack. This task evaluates deformable-object manipulation, bimanual coordination, and grasp transitions across multiple stages of manipulation.

Pack Tennis Canister(178次演示)。 机器人必须伸进深厚的纸板箱,以取回网球罐,打开一个袋子,把罐子放进去. 这项任务评价了限制空间的伸展和双人操纵,要求机器人在到达内部时,在箱边周围摆动肘部. 3. 获取饮料(219次示威)。 机器人必须打开冰箱,到达里面取回饮料罐,并关上门,同时避免附近的雪橇. 这项任务通过头部角度的不匹配来评价明确对象的操纵和稳健性。 4. 折叠箱(393次示威)。 机器人必须将一个纸板空白折叠到一个盒子中,插入边标签,并挤压边缘以保障它的安全. 这一任务通过折叠,插入,挤压等一系列操作来评价精确,丰富的双手操作. 5. 吊衣(261次示威)。 机器人必须拿起吊架,插入夹克,将衣物包裹在吊架周围,挂在吊架上. 这项任务评价可变形对象操纵,双人协调,并把握跨操纵多个阶段的过渡.

blocks.en: IV-B Policy Details
blocks.zh: 四-B 政策细节

blocks.en:
We use single-task policies for all ablation experiments.
For Arrange Mouse, Pack Tennis Canister, and Retrieve Drink, we train policies using only human demonstrations. For Fold Box and Hang Jacket, we first train on human demonstrations, then add 60 successful on-policy robot correction demonstrations per task in each of two rounds.
blocks.zh:
我们使用单一任务政策 用于所有的消化实验。
我们训练的政策只使用人类的演示。 对Fold Box和Hang Jacket来说,我们首先进行关于人类演示的训练,然后在每两轮任务中增加60个成功的政策机器人矫正演示.

blocks.en: The policy uses pretrained DINOv3 [ 23 ] ViT-B/16 visual backbones and a flow-matching [ 24 ] action decoder, following the Pixel system paper [ 11 ] . Unless otherwise stated, the policy receives synchronized RGB images from the head camera and both wrist cameras, along with robot joint states. Head images are processed at 384 × 384 384\times 384 and wrist images at 224 × 224 224\times 224 .
blocks.zh: 政策采用预训的DINOv3 [23] VIT-B/16视觉主干线和一个流量匹配 [24] 动作解码器,遵循像素系统纸张 [11]. 除非另有说明,否则政策接收来自头摄像头和两个手腕摄像头的同步RGB图像,以及机器人联合状态. 头像处理时间为384×384\时,腕像处理时间为224×224\时.

blocks.en: We initialize the action decoder from scratch and jointly fine-tune the pretrained visual backbones for 150,000 optimizer updates.
blocks.zh: 我们从零开始初始化动作解码器,并联合微调经过预训的视觉骨干,用于15万个优化器更新.

blocks.en: The policy predicts a chunk of 50 actions spanning one second at a control rate of 50 ​ Hz 50\,\mathrm{Hz} . Each 23-dimensional action contains 20 absolute position targets for the lift, torso, arms, head, and grippers, together with the planar base velocities ( v x B , v y B , ω ) (v_{x}^{B},v_{y}^{B},\omega) expressed in the robot base frame. These commands are sent directly to the low-level controllers during rollout, without an online task-space whole-body controller.
blocks.zh: 策略预测50个动作, 跨越1秒, 控制速度为 50 Hz 50\,\ mathrm{ Hz}. 每个23维的动作包含20个绝对位置目标,用于提升,躯干,手臂,头部和抓手,以及平面基速度(v x B,v y B,ω) (v_{x}^{B},v_{y}^{B},\omega)在机器人基框中表示. 这些命令在推出时直接发送给低级控制器,没有在线任务空间全体控制器.

blocks.en: We use real-time chunking (RTC) [ 22 ] as in the system paper. This compensates for inference latency and smooths transitions between consecutive action chunks.
blocks.zh: 我们像系统文件一样使用实时块(RTC)[22]。 这弥补了推论延迟和连续动作块之间的平稳过渡.

blocks.en: IV-C Environment Awareness
blocks.zh: 四-C 环境意识

blocks.en: EAR optimizes robot motion offline to avoid collisions with the environment. We evaluate whether this supervision leads to collision avoidance during policy rollout and improves task performance. We choose three tasks that impose different geometric constraints. Pack Tennis Canister requires an arm configuration that keeps the elbow clear of the box rim while the gripper reaches inside. Arrange Mouse requires whole-body coordination during motion, as the robot must dynamically adjust its posture to avoid the chair while retrieving and placing the mouse. Retrieve Drink requires the arms to reach inside the refrigerator without collision while the base remains clear of the adjacent cabinet. We evaluate the following two experimental conditions:
blocks.zh: EAR优化了机器人离线运动,以避免与环境发生碰撞. 我们评价这种监督是否导致在政策推出期间避免碰撞,并改善任务执行情况。 我们选择了三项任务,规定了不同的几何限制。 网球包装 罐头需要一种臂部配置,在抓手到达内部时,使肘部保持没有夹住箱边. 排列鼠标需要在运动过程中进行全身协调,因为机器人必须动态调整其姿势,在回收和放置鼠标时避开椅子. 取回饮料需要手臂到达冰箱内部而不发生碰撞,而基部则远离相邻的柜子. 我们评价以下两个实验条件:

blocks.en: EAR only. We use trajectories retargeted with environment collision avoidance enabled.
blocks.zh: 仅限EAR。 我们使用可避免环境碰撞的轨迹。

blocks.en: No environment awareness. We use trajectories retargeted without environment collision avoidance.
blocks.zh: 没有环境意识。 我们使用重新瞄准的轨迹而不避免环境碰撞。

blocks.en: Both conditions retain self-collision avoidance and use absolute joint-space control with the full observation space described above. REAM is disabled in both conditions.
blocks.zh: 这两种条件都保留了自我碰撞的避免,并使用了绝对的联动空间控制,并具有上述完全的观测空间. REAM在两种情况下都是残疾人.

blocks.en: IV-D Action Representation and Assignment
blocks.zh: 四-D 行动代表与指派

blocks.en: We first compare three action representations on Arrange Mouse, Pack Tennis Canister, and Retrieve Drink to assess how the action space affects transfer of EAR’s whole-body motion.
blocks.zh: 我们首先比较了Arange Mouse、Pack Tennis Canister和Retrieve Drink三个动作说明,以评估动作空间如何影响EAR全身运动的转移。

blocks.en: Joint Abs. The policy predicts absolute joint-position targets together with planar base velocities, directly specifying the robot’s whole-body posture.
blocks.zh: 联合Abs. 政策预测绝对联合定位目标与平面基速度,直接指定机器人的全身姿态.

blocks.en: Joint Rel. The policy expresses joint targets as relative offsets while retaining the same base-velocity commands.
blocks.zh: 联合雷尔。 该政策表示联合目标为相对抵销,同时保留同样的基速度指令.

blocks.en: EEF-Rel Base. Following the relative-base representation in the Pixel system paper [ 11 ] , the policy predicts head and bimanual end-effector target poses in a shared, ground-referenced pseudo-base frame for each action chunk. We retain joint angles for the gripper. An online whole-body controller converts these targets into robot motion. This tests whether task-space targets suffice without directly learning EAR’s posture choices.
blocks.zh: EEF-雷尔基地. 在Pixel系统文件[11]中的相对基准表示之后,政策预测头和双元最终效果目标在每个动作块的共享的地面参照伪基准框架中构成。 我们保留了关节角度的抓手。 一个在线全体控制器将这些目标转换为机器人运动. 测试任务空间目标是否足够而不直接学习 EAR 的姿态选择 。

blocks.en: Based on this comparison, we select Joint Abs and test whether accounting for joint response delays improves performance. We hold the retargeted state trajectories fixed and compare two action-labeling schemes:
blocks.zh: 基于这一比较,我们选择了联合Abs并测试联合反应延迟的核算是否改善了性能. 我们定下目标状态轨迹,比较两个行动标记方案:

blocks.en: Calibrated labels. We assign joint targets using per-joint lookahead settings calibrated from previously collected robot teleoperation data, following Section III-B4 .
blocks.zh: 校准标签。 我们按照第三节B4,根据以往收集的机器人远程操作数据,使用每个联合搜索头设置来设定联合目标。

blocks.en: Next-state labels. We use the next retargeted joint state as the action, providing a reference without per-joint delay calibration.
blocks.zh: 下一州标签. 我们使用下一个重新设定目标的联合状态作为行动,提供无需每次联合延迟校准的参考.

blocks.en: All action-representation and assignment conditions use EAR and the full observation space, with REAM disabled.
blocks.zh: 所有动作表示和任务分配条件都使用EAR和完整的观测空间,REAM被禁用.

blocks.en: IV-E Observation Space and Retargeting Error Aware Masking
blocks.zh: IV-E 观测空间和重定向误差

blocks.en: Retargeting cannot always reproduce the demonstrated head and wrist poses exactly, creating viewpoint mismatches between human training images and robot observations at deployment. We investigate how camera observations and head-tracking objectives affect policy performance on Arrange Mouse, Pack Tennis Canister, and Retrieve Drink. We compare four conditions:
blocks.zh: 重新瞄准目标并不总是能够完全复制显示的头部和手腕,在部署时造成人体训练图像和机器人观测之间的视线不匹配。 我们调查摄像头观察和头部跟踪目标如何影响 安排鼠标、网球罐头包装和回旋饮料的政策性能。 我们比较了四个条件:

blocks.en: All cameras (EAR only). We use standard head and wrist retargeting and train with all three camera views, with REAM disabled.
blocks.zh: 所有摄像头(只有EAR). 我们使用标准头和手腕重新瞄准并训练,所有三个相机视图,REAM被禁用.

blocks.en: Wrist only. We retarget only the wrist poses and use only the two wrist cameras during training and deployment, with REAM disabled. This tests whether removing the head view and its tracking objective improves transfer despite the loss of visual context.
blocks.zh: 唯手执. 我们只重新瞄准手腕姿势,在训练和部署时只使用两个手腕相机,REAM被禁用. 尽管失去了视觉上下文,但这种测试是否移除了头视图及其跟踪目标会改善传输.

blocks.en: Relaxed head tracking. We reduce the head-pose tracking weight during retargeting while retaining all three cameras, with REAM disabled. This tests whether favoring wrist tracking at the expense of head alignment improves transfer.
blocks.zh: 放松头部跟踪。 在重新瞄准时,我们减少头像跟踪重量,同时保留所有三台摄像机,REAM已停用。 这种测试是否倾向于手腕跟踪而牺牲头部对齐可以改善转移.

blocks.en: REAM. We retain standard retargeting and all three cameras, but mask camera observations during training according to their retargeting pose errors. This tests whether error-guided masking can mitigate viewpoint mismatch while preserving visual context at deployment.
blocks.zh: 现实。 我们保留标准的重定向和所有三台相机,但是在训练期间根据重定向进行遮罩相机观测时,会出现错误. 此测试错误制导的遮罩能否在部署时保留视觉环境的同时减轻视线不匹配.

blocks.en: All conditions use EAR, Joint Abs actions, and calibrated action assignment. For REAM, we use an 80th-percentile cutoff ( ρ = 0.8 \rho=0.8 ) and a maximum masking probability of 90% ( p max = 0.9 p_{\max}=0.9 ) in Equation 7 . The masking probability is zero at or below the cutoff and increases quadratically for higher error-rank scores. Masking is applied only during training; all three cameras remain available at deployment.
blocks.zh: 所有条件都使用EAR,联合Abs动作,以及校准动作任务. 对于REAM,在方程式中使用80分之一的截断(ρ = 0.8\rho= 0.8)和最大遮掩概率为90%(p max = 0.9 p_{\max}=0.9). 7 (英语). 遮掩概率在截断点或下方为0,并且为较高的误差排名分数四倍递增. 面具只在训练期间使用;部署时仍然有三台摄像机。

blocks.en: IV-F On-Policy Correction
blocks.zh: 四-F 政策纠正

blocks.en: We evaluate whether DAgger [ 10 ] improves policies trained on human demonstrations and which parts of the collected robot data are most useful. We study Fold Box and Hang Jacket, which require long-horizon, contact-rich bimanual manipulation.
blocks.zh: 我们评价Dagger[10]是否改进了经过人类演示培训的政策,以及所收集的机器人数据中哪些部分最有用. 我们研究Fold Box和Hang Jacket, 需要长距离, 丰富的双手操作。

blocks.en: Starting from a human-trained policy, an operator corrects rollout errors using the procedure in Section III-D . We collect 60 successful corrected robot rollouts per task in each of two rounds, for a total of 120 per task. We compare three training conditions:
blocks.zh: 从经过人力训练的政策开始,操作员使用第三节D中的程序纠正推出错误。 我们每两回合收集60个成功修正的机器人推出,每轮共120个。 我们比较了三个训练条件:

blocks.en: Full rollouts. We combine human demonstrations with complete corrected robot rollouts, including both policy-executed and operator-controlled segments.
blocks.zh: 全面展开. 我们把人类的演示与完全修正的机器人推出结合起来,包括政策执行部分和操作员控制的部分。

blocks.en: Interventions only. We combine human demonstrations with only the operator-controlled segments of the same rollouts. Comparison with Full rollouts tests the value of retaining policy-executed segments alongside corrections.
blocks.zh: 仅限干预。 我们把人类的示威活动 和同一场比赛的操作控制部分结合起来 与全面推出的比较检验了保留政策执行部分以及更正的价值。

blocks.en: Robot-only demos. We train on all complete robot rollouts from both rounds without human demonstrations, testing whether human data remain useful once robot correction data are available.
blocks.zh: 仅限机器人演示. 测试一旦有机器人校正数据 人类数据是否依然有用

blocks.en: After each round, we retrain Full rollouts and Interventions only from scratch on the original human dataset plus their respective robot data accumulated across all completed rounds. The policy trained after round one is used to collect round two. All conditions use uniform sampling.
blocks.zh: 每回合后,我们只从头开始重新训练全面展开和干预,在原始的人类数据集上加上各自在所有已完成回合中积累的机器人数据。 第一回合结束后训练的政策用于收集第二回合. 所有条件都采用统一的取样。

blocks.en: V Results
blocks.zh: 五 结果

blocks.en: Videos of results are available at https://pixel-robot.com/pixel-umi
blocks.zh: 结果的视频可在https://pixel-robot.com/pixel-umi上查阅。

blocks.en: Fig. 8: EAR and action-representation ablations. (a) EAR only versus retargeting without environment awareness. (b) EEF-Rel Base versus Joint Rel and Joint Abs. Both panels omit REAM.
blocks.zh: 图8:EAR和代表行动的事件。 (a) 仅针对环境评估,而不针对环境认识。 (b) EEF-Rel基地对联合雷尔和联合阿布。 两个面板都省略REAM.

blocks.en: Fig. 9: Action-assignment and REAM ablations. (a) Robot-calibrated command labels versus next-state labels, with REAM omitted. (b) Pixel-UMI (EAR + REAM) versus EAR only, wrist-only observations, and relaxed head tracking.
blocks.zh: 图9:行动任务和REAM计划。 (a) 机器人校准命令标签相对于邻态标签,REAM省略。 (b) Pixel-UMI(EAR +REAM)仅对EAR,只手腕观测,并放松头部跟踪.

blocks.en: V-A EAR Improves Whole-Body Manipulation
blocks.zh: V-A EAR 改进全Body操纵

blocks.en: As shown in Figure 8 , EAR improves task progress across all three tasks, increasing average progress by 64.41 percentage points over retargeting without environment awareness. The largest gains occur in Arrange Mouse and Pack Tennis Canister, where nearby obstacles constrain the body configurations needed to complete the task.
blocks.zh: 如图8所示,EAR提高了所有三项任务的任务进度,比没有环境意识的重新确定目标的平均进度增加了64.41个百分点。 最大的收益出现在Arrange Mouse和Pack Tennis Canister,其中附近的障碍限制了完成任务所需的身体配置.

blocks.en: In Pack Tennis Canister, the policy trained without environment awareness hits the box rim with its elbow as the gripper descends. This collision prevents the robot from reaching the canister, resulting in zero task progress. EAR instead supplies training trajectories that keep the elbow clear of the rim while allowing the gripper to reach into the box. In Arrange Mouse, the policy trained without environment awareness often collides with the chair, either while approaching the mouse or after grasping it and moving toward the mouse pad. Avoiding these collisions requires coordinating the robot’s body throughout both retrieval and placement. EAR also improves Retrieve Drink, where the robot must reach into the refrigerator while remaining clear of nearby shelving and cabinets.
blocks.zh: 在网球包装中 罐头,在没有环境意识的情况下训练的政策随着抓手的下降而打中了箱边。 这次碰撞使机器人无法到达罐头,导致零任务进展. 相反,EAR则提供训练轨迹,使肘部远离边缘,同时让抓手伸进盒子. 在《安排鼠标》中,在没有环境意识的情况下培训的政策往往与椅子相撞,要么接近鼠标,要么在抓住鼠标后转向鼠标垫。 避免这些碰撞需要在整个回收和放置过程中协调机器人的身体。 EAR还改进了Retrive Drink,机器人必须到达冰箱,同时保持远离附近的壳和柜子.

blocks.en: The qualitative comparison in Figure 4 illustrates how incorporating scene geometry during retargeting changes the robot’s whole-body posture. These scene-aware configurations provide the policies with a strong prior for moving around obstacles while continuing the demonstrated manipulation. The results support using environment geometry during offline retargeting to teach policies the coordinated body motion needed for manipulation in constrained spaces.
blocks.zh: 图4中的质量比较表明,在重新瞄准目标时纳入场景几何方法如何改变机器人的整体姿势。 这些场景感知配置为政策提供了在继续明显操纵的同时绕过障碍的强大前驱。 成果支持在离线重新瞄准时使用环境几何技术,向政策传授在受限制空间操纵所需的协调体运动。

blocks.en: V-B Absolute Joint Targets and Delay Calibration Improve Policy Performance
blocks.zh: V-B 绝对联合目标和延迟校准

blocks.en: With EAR enabled, Joint Abs outperforms EEF-Rel Base and Joint Rel across all three tasks in Figure 8 , achieving 77.74% average task progress compared with 25.12% and 27.50%, respectively. EEF-Rel Base specifies head and end-effector poses but leaves the remaining body configuration to an online whole-body controller. These targets underspecify the posture needed to avoid nearby obstacles, and the controller often produces motions that collide with the environment. In Pack Tennis Canister, this representation fails to preserve the elbow configuration needed to reach inside the box, resulting in zero task progress.
blocks.zh: 随着EAR的启用,联合Abs在EEF-Rel Base和联合Rel的所有三项任务上的表现都超过了图8,平均任务进度达到77.74%,而分别为25.12%和27.50%。 EEF-Rel Base指定了头部和末端效果器的姿势,但剩下的身体配置留给在线全体控制器. 这些目标低估了避免附近障碍所需的姿态,控制器往往产生与环境相撞的运动. 在Pack Tennis Canister中,这种表示法未能保存到盒子内所需的肘部配置,导致零任务进展.

blocks.en: Fig. 10: Policy improvement through DAgger. We compare training on complete corrected rollouts with intervention segments only. Gray markers show policies trained on robot demonstrations alone.
blocks.zh: 费格。 10:通过Dagger改进政策. 我们只将关于完全改正的推出的培训与干预部分进行比较。 灰色标记显示仅就机器人演示训练过的政策.

blocks.en: Joint Rel retains joint-level supervision from EAR’s environment-aware trajectories. However, errors accumulate across relative commands, causing the robot to drift away from the demonstrated trajectories and quickly encounter states outside the training distribution. This is particularly problematic for tasks requiring precise positioning. In Retrieve Drink, the gripper must enter a small notch in the refrigerator door to open it. With Joint Rel, accumulated errors often cause the gripper to miss this notch, preventing further progress. Joint Abs directly specifies the target joint configuration at each step, helping preserve both the demonstrated posture and the precision needed for these interactions.
blocks.zh: 联合 Rel对EAR的环境意识轨迹保留联合级别监督. 然而,错误在相对指令之间累积,导致机器人偏离已演示的轨迹,并很快在训练分发之外遇到状态. 这对需要精确定位的任务来说尤其成问题。 在Retrieve Drink中,抓手必须在冰箱门内输入一个小口子才能打开. 随着联合雷尔的出现,累积的错误往往导致抓手错过这个音符,阻碍了进一步的进展. 联合 Abs直接指定了每个步骤的目标联合配置,帮助保持这些互动所需的显示姿态和精确度.

blocks.en: Holding Joint Abs fixed, we next compare calibrated action assignment with next-state labels. Figure 9 shows that calibration increases average task progress by 24.05 percentage points, with the clearest gains on Arrange Mouse and Retrieve Drink. Pack Tennis Canister benefits relatively little. We hypothesize that faster motions amplify tracking errors caused by joint response delays. Arrange Mouse requires large, coordinated motions while avoiding the chair, making accurate timing across joints particularly important. For slower, posture-dominated motions, such as reaching into the box in Pack Tennis Canister, these dynamic differences may have less impact on policy performance.
blocks.zh: 联合持有 Abs固定了,我们接下来将校准动作任务与邻邦标签进行比较. 图9显示,校准使平均任务进度增加了24.05个百分点,其中排列鼠标和检索饮料的成绩最明显. Pack Tennis Canister的受益相对较少. 我们假设更快的运动会扩大联合反应延迟造成的追踪错误。 排列鼠标需要大而协调的动作,同时避开椅子,使得跨关节的准确时间尤为重要. 对于较慢的,以姿态为主的运动,如到达Pack Tennis Canister的盒子,这些动态差异可能对政策业绩的影响较小.

blocks.en: V-C REAM Improves Performance with All Camera Views
blocks.zh: V-C REAM 以所有相机视图改进性能

blocks.en: The observation ablations in Figure 9 highlight the importance of head-camera context for whole-body manipulation. Although the wrist-only condition performs well on Pack Tennis Canister and Retrieve Drink, it achieves only 20% task progress on Arrange Mouse, compared with 82.5% for EAR only using all cameras. During parts of Arrange Mouse, the arms are positioned in front of the chair, leaving this obstacle outside the wrist-camera views. The head camera provides the broader scene context needed to coordinate motion around it. Consequently, relying only on wrist observations produces uneven performance across tasks with different visual-context requirements.
blocks.zh: 图9中的观测显示,头摄像头背景对全身操纵的重要性。 虽然只手腕条件在Pack Tennis Canister和Retrive Drink上表现良好,但在Arrange Mouse上只实现了20%的任务进度,而EAR只使用所有相机的为82.5%. 在排列鼠标的部分地区,手臂被放在椅子前,将这个障碍留在手腕-相机视角之外. 头摄像头提供了协调周围运动所需的更广泛的场景背景. 因此,仅依靠手腕观察就会产生不同视觉文字要求的任务之间不均匀的表现。

blocks.en: Retaining all cameras without REAM performs well on Arrange Mouse and Pack Tennis Canister, but underperforms the wrist-only condition on Retrieve Drink. The robot’s kinematic constraints prevent accurate reproduction of the demonstrated head poses, creating a mismatch between human training images and robot observations during rollout. In Retrieve Drink, EAR-only failures frequently occur at the task stage corresponding to the largest head-pose errors in the demonstrations. This correspondence is consistent with our hypothesis that viewpoint mismatch contributes to the performance degradation.
blocks.zh: 保留所有没有REAM的摄像头在Arrange Mouse和Pack Tennis Canister上表现良好,但在Retrieve Drink上却表现不佳,只限手腕. 机器人的动能限制阻止了所显示头部的准确复制,在推出时造成了人体训练影像和机器人观测的不匹配. 在 Retrive Drink 中, EAR 唯一的失败经常发生在任务阶段,与演示中最大的头-头错误相对应. 这种对应符合我们的假设,即观点不匹配导致性能退化。

blocks.en: To examine this tradeoff, we relax the head-tracking objective to prioritize wrist tracking while retaining all camera observations. Performance degrades further across all three tasks relative to EAR only. These results suggest that prioritizing wrist tracking at the expense of head alignment does not resolve the observation mismatch when the policy continues to receive the head view.
blocks.zh: 为了检查这种权衡,我们放松头跟踪目标,在保留所有摄像头观察的同时,优先进行手腕跟踪. 在所有三项任务中,性能都比EAR进一步下降。 这些结果表明,以牺牲头部对齐为代价优先进行手腕跟踪并不能解决当政策继续收到头部视图时的观察不匹配问题.

blocks.en: Combining all cameras with REAM achieves the highest average task progress among the observation conditions, at 91.79%, an improvement of 14.05 percentage points over EAR only. REAM recovers most of the performance lost on Retrieve Drink while retaining the head-camera context needed for Arrange Mouse; performance on Pack Tennis Canister remains comparable. This provides strong performance across tasks without removing a camera from the policy.
blocks.zh: 将所有摄像头与REAM结合后,观测条件的平均任务进度最高,达到91.79%,仅比EAR提高14.05个百分点. REAM恢复了Retrieve Drink上失去的大部分性能,同时保留了Arrange Mouse所需的头-相机上下文;Pack Tennis Canister上的性能仍然相当. 这在不从政策中删除相机的情况下,能很好地完成各项任务。

blocks.en: Figure 6 provides a qualitative example from a Retrieve Drink training demonstration. Relative attention to the head camera decreases during the interval with the largest head-pose error. This aligns with the intended role of REAM: reducing reliance on poorly matched views at particular moments in a trajectory while preserving access to useful context from the available cameras.
blocks.zh: 图6提供了检索饮料培训示范的定性实例。 对头部相机的相对关注在相隔期间随着头-pose 最大的错误而减少. 这与REAM的预期作用是一致的:在轨迹的特定时刻,减少对不匹配观点的依赖,同时保留从现有摄像头获取有用背景。

blocks.en: V-D DAgger Improves Performance Across Rounds
blocks.zh: V-D Dugger 提高整个回合的性能

blocks.en: On Fold Box and Hang Jacket, each round of DAgger improves policy performance, as shown in Figure 10 . With Full rollouts, average task progress across the two tasks increases from 6.82% for the initial human-trained policy to 50.68% after the first round and 79.77% after the second. Interventions only also improves substantially, reaching 47.27% and 69.77% after the corresponding rounds. Retaining complete corrected rollouts therefore yields higher average performance than training only on intervention segments.
blocks.zh: 如图10所示,在Fold Box和Hang Jacket上,每一轮Dagger改进了政策性能。 随着全面展开,这两项任务的平均任务进度从最初的人力培训政策6.82%增加到第一轮后50.68%,第二轮后79.77%。 干预措施也大有改进,在相应回合之后达到47.27%和69.77%。 因此,保持完整的经更正的推广,其平均业绩高于只对干预部门进行培训。

blocks.en: We observe that each round enables the policy to complete additional task stages, allowing subsequent corrections to address failures later in the task. This progression helps explain the approximately linear increase in task progress over the two evaluated rounds: successive rounds extend how far the policy can execute the task successfully. We expect longer tasks with more subtask stages to require additional rounds of correction to achieve comparable progress.
blocks.zh: 我们注意到,每一回合都使政策能够完成额外的任务阶段,从而能够随后进行更正,以解决任务后期的失败。 这一进展有助于解释在两轮评估中任务进展大约呈线性增长的原因:连续几轮延长了政策能够成功执行任务的范围。 我们期望任务更长,分任务阶段更多,需要更多几轮更正,以取得类似进展。

blocks.en: Robot-only demos also performs strongly, achieving 73.41% average task progress using the same collected robot rollouts without human demonstrations in the final training dataset, compared with 79.77% when human demonstrations are retained. However, these rollouts were collected by correcting policies initially trained on human demonstrations. Collecting successful robot demonstrations for these tasks is often difficult without this initial policy, so human demonstrations remain valuable for making correction-data collection practical.
blocks.zh: 只有机器人的演示也表现强劲,在最后的训练数据集中,使用同样收集的机器人推出,没有人类演示,实现了73.41%的平均任务进度,而保留人类演示时为79.77%. 然而,这些推广是通过纠正最初经过人类示威培训的政策来收集的。 如果没有这种初步政策,为这些任务收集成功的机器人演示往往很困难,因此人类演示对于使校正数据收集实用性仍然很有价值.

blocks.en: VI Related Work
blocks.zh: 六. 相关工作

blocks.en: VI-A Sensorized Human Demonstrations and Embodiment Transfer
blocks.zh: VI-A 人类敏感示威和安葬转移

blocks.en: Sensorized human interfaces enable demonstration collection without requiring a robot at the collection site. Gripper-based interfaces reduce the embodiment gap by aligning the demonstration tool and camera placement with the robot’s manipulation interface, with subsequent designs improving tracking, ergonomics, and collection scalability [ 25 , 26 , 27 , 3 , 28 , 29 ] . Wearable interfaces offer alternative tradeoffs: exoskeletons align recorded motion with robot kinematics [ 30 , 31 , 32 ] , while instrumented gloves capture natural hand motion for subsequent retargeting [ 33 , 34 ] . Egocentric bare-hand capture further reduces instrumentation, using human–robot co-training to connect human observations and motion to robot behavior [ 35 ] . Related industrial efforts also emphasize scalable collection of sensorized-interaction data [ 4 , 36 ] .
blocks.zh: 感知人机界面可以实现演示采集,而无需在采集现场安装机器人. 基于Gripper的接口通过将演示工具和相机布置与机器人的操纵界面对齐,从而缩小了浮雕间隙,随后的设计改进了跟踪,人机学,以及收集可扩展性[25,26,27,3,28,29]. 可穿戴的接口提供了替代的权衡:exoskeletons将录制的动作与机器人动能配合[30,31,32],而器械手套则捕捉自然的手动,以便随后重新瞄准[33,34]. Egocentral 光手捕捉进一步减少仪器,利用人-机器人协同训练将人类的观测和运动与机器人行为联系起来[35]. 相关的工业努力还强调了可扩展的传感器交互数据的收集[4、36]。

blocks.en: Beyond hand-centric manipulation, interfaces that jointly record head and hand motion provide broader scene context and demonstrations of active perception [ 6 , 37 ] . Mobile manipulation systems combine human motion with robot data or whole-body control to coordinate navigation and manipulation [ 38 , 5 ] . Humanoid extensions explore both additional pelvis and foot tracking to specify body motion and simpler head-and-hand interfaces that delegate the remaining coordination to learned controllers [ 39 , 40 ] .
blocks.zh: 除了手心操控之外,联合记录头部和手动的界面提供了更广泛的场景背景和主动感知的表现[6,37]. 移动操纵系统将人类运动与机器人数据或全身控制相结合,以协调导航和操纵[38,5]. Humanoid扩展探索额外的骨盆和脚步跟踪,以指定身体运动和更简单的头部和手部接口,将剩余的协调委托给学习的控制器[39,40].

blocks.en: Transferring these demonstrations requires aligning both observations and actions across embodiments. Visual adaptation methods replace human appearance with robot imagery [ 31 , 32 ] , mask embodiment-specific features or use geometry-aware representations [ 35 , 5 ] , and reproject observations toward the robot viewpoint [ 40 ] . Motion adaptation addresses robot kinematic constraints through retargeting and constrained control [ 38 , 5 ] , while latency compensation and controller-aware trajectory adjustment account for differences between recorded motion and executed actions [ 3 , 40 ] . Force-sensing interfaces additionally capture interaction wrenches for learning force-aware and compliant manipulation [ 8 , 9 ] .
blocks.zh: 转移这些示威需要将观察和行动相互配合。 视觉改造方法将人类外观替换为机器人图像[31,32],面具化石特异性特征或使用几何感知表现[35,5],并重新预测对机器人视角的观测[40]. 适应运动通过重新瞄准和限制控制来解决机器人的运动限制[38,5],而延迟补偿和控制器-意识轨迹调整则反映了记录的运动和执行行动之间的差别[3,40]. 强感界面额外捕捉互动扳机,用于学习强感和遵义操控[8,9].

blocks.en: Our work complements these approaches through scene-aware whole-body retargeting, retargeting-error-guided camera masking, and delay-calibrated action assignment, followed by on-policy correction.
blocks.zh: 我们的工作通过场景感知全身重定向、重定向-错误-制导相机遮罩和延迟校准行动任务以及随后的政策纠正来补充这些方法。

blocks.en: VI-B Learning for Whole-Body Mobile Manipulation
blocks.zh: 六-B 全面博迪移动操纵学习

blocks.en: Behavior cloning naturally extends to mobile manipulation, provided that suitable demonstration data can be collected. Whole-body teleoperation provides demonstrations of coordinated base and arm motion, enabling learned policies to perform diverse household tasks [ 1 , 41 , 2 ] . Action-chunking and diffusion-based policies provide effective architectures for learning visuomotor behavior from these demonstrations [ 42 , 43 ] . Simulation can further expand source demonstrations across new task configurations while accounting for reachability and camera visibility [ 44 ] .
blocks.zh: 行为克隆自然延伸至移动操纵,前提是可以收集适当的演示数据. 全机构电信业务提供协调基础和武装运动的示范,使有学识的政策能够执行各种家庭任务[1、41、2]。 基于行动和传播的政策为从这些示范中学习运动行为提供了有效的架构[42、43]。 模拟可以进一步扩大新任务配置的源演示,同时考虑可达到性和相机能见度[44].

blocks.en: Human demonstrations provide a complementary source of supervision without requiring mobile robot teleoperation. Several approaches learn task-space policies from human demonstrations and use inverse kinematics or whole-body controllers to execute their predictions [ 45 , 46 , 5 ] . Other methods combine human mobile-manipulation data with stationary robot demonstrations [ 38 ] , or extend human demonstration learning to humanoids through hierarchical policies and learned motion controllers [ 39 , 40 ] . Offline retargeting instead converts recorded human motion into robot joint trajectories before policy training [ 47 ] .
blocks.zh: 人类示威提供了一个补充性的监督来源,不需要移动机器人远程操作. 几种方法从人类的演示中学习任务空间政策,并使用逆动能或全身控制器来进行预测[45、46、5]。 其他方法将人类移动操纵数据与固定机器人演示结合[38],或者通过分级政策和学习的运动控制器将人类演示学习扩展到人体. [39,40]. 离线重新瞄准相反在政策训练前将记录下来的人类运动转换为机器人联合轨道[47].

blocks.en: Reinforcement learning provides another route to acquiring coordinated mobile-manipulation behavior. Simulation-trained policies learn base placement and navigation conditioned on manipulation goals [ 48 , 49 ] , coupled locomotion and arm control [ 50 ] , and visual coordination of movement, manipulation, and perception [ 51 , 52 ] . Hybrid approaches combine a demonstration-trained visual planner with an RL controller [ 53 ] . COWBOY combines environment-aware whole-body control for reaching with local RL experts for object interaction, then distills their behavior into a single visual whole-body policy [ 54 ] . Beyond simulation, autonomous real-world RL has also enabled navigation and grasping to improve through robot interaction [ 55 ] .
blocks.zh: 强化学习为获得协调的移动操纵行为提供了另一种途径. 模拟训练政策学习基础定位和导航,以操纵目标[48,49]为条件,结合运动和手臂控制[50],对运动、操纵和感觉进行视觉协调[51,52]。 混合式方法将演示训练的视觉规划器与RL控制器相结合[53]. COWBOY结合了环境意识全体控制,以接触当地RL专家进行物体相互作用,然后将其行为提炼成单一视觉全体政策[54]. 除了模拟之外,自主现实世界的RL还使得导航和把握能够通过机器人交互来改进[55].

blocks.en: Our work focuses on learning whole-body policies from sensorized human demonstrations, using environment-aware retargeting to construct robot motion supervision and on-policy correction to improve performance.
blocks.zh: 我们的工作重点是从感官化的人类演示中学习全体政策,利用环境意识的重新瞄准来构建机器人运动监督以及政策矫正,以提高性能.

blocks.en: VI-C Continual Improvement of Robot Policies
blocks.zh: 不断改进机器人政策

blocks.en: Once an initial policy is available, further interaction can improve its reliability and task performance. Some reinforcement learning approaches learn residual corrections around a frozen behavior-cloning policy [ 56 , 57 ] , or combine learned action edits with value-based action selection [ 58 , 59 ] . Other approaches directly fine-tune diffusion policies [ 60 , 61 ] or train lightweight actor–critic heads using pretrained VLA representations [ 62 ] . RL can also generate data for subsequent supervised refinement, using residual specialists to collect recovery trajectories that are distilled back into a generalist policy [ 63 ] .
blocks.zh: 一旦有了初步政策,进一步的互动就能提高其可靠性和任务性能。 一些强化学习方法围绕冻结行为克隆政策[56,57]学习残余矫正,或将所学行动的编辑与基于价值的行动选择[58,59]结合起来. 其它方法直接微调传播政策[60,61],或使用预先训练的VLA代表来训练轻量级演员-批评头目[62]. RL还可以生成数据供后续监督完善,使用剩余专家来收集回收轨迹,这些轨迹被提炼回归纳政策[63].

blocks.en: Interactive imitation learning improves policies through expert feedback on their own execution. DAgger addresses distribution shift by collecting expert action labels at states visited by the learned policy and iteratively training on the aggregated dataset [ 10 ] . Subsequent methods make this process more practical by selectively requesting supervision. Human-gated approaches let operators decide when to take control [ 20 ] , while robot-gated approaches use novelty and estimated risk to request interventions within a supervision budget [ 64 ] .
blocks.zh: 互动模仿学习通过专家对自身执行的反馈来改进政策. Dagger通过在所学政策访问的国家收集专家行动标签和关于汇总数据集的迭代培训,解决分布转移问题。 随后的方法通过有选择地要求监督,使这一过程更加实用. 由人类采取的办法让运营商决定何时控制[20],而由机器人采取的办法利用新颖性和估计风险要求在监督预算范围内进行干预[64]。

blocks.en: For manipulation, the correction interface determines what feedback humans can provide. Compliant bilateral teleoperation supports smooth handovers between autonomous execution and human control [ 65 ] , while kinesthetic interfaces allow humans to provide residual motion and force corrections during ongoing policy execution [ 66 ] . Correction protocols also shape the behaviors learned: combining recovery to familiar states with corrective task completion teaches policies to retry and adapt during long-horizon manipulation [ 21 ] .
blocks.zh: 对于操纵,校正界面决定了人类能够提供何种反馈. 和谐的双边远程操作支持自主执行与人控之间的顺利交接[65],而亲子美学接口则允许人类在进行中的政策执行中提供剩余运动和强迫矫正[66]. 校正协议还塑造了所学行为:将恢复与熟悉的状态结合到校正任务完成中,教导政策在长距离操纵期间重试和适应[21].

blocks.en: Another question is how to learn from rollouts containing both autonomous rollouts and human corrections. Weighted imitation methods balance these data sources and use intervention signals to prioritize informative behavior [ 67 , 68 ] . Preference-based approaches additionally use these signals to reinforce corrective actions and suppress failure-prone behavior [ 69 ] . Distributed systems extend this improvement loop across robot fleets, coupling experience collection with frequent policy updates through either interactive imitation learning or RL [ 70 ] . We study interactive improvement for whole-body policies initialized from sensorized human demonstrations, comparing aggregation of complete corrected rollouts with intervention segments alone.
blocks.zh: 另一个问题是,如何从包含自主推出和人类矫正的推出中学习。 加权仿真方法平衡了这些数据来源,并使用干预信号来优先考虑信息行为[67,68]. 以优惠为基础的办法还利用这些信号加强纠正行动和抑制容易发生故障的行为[69]。 分布式系统将这一改进循环延伸至机器人机队之间,通过交互式仿真学习或RL[70]将经验集与频繁的政策更新相配合. 我们研究从感官化的人类演示中初始化的全体政策的互动改进,将完全校正的推广与干预部分的汇总进行比较。

blocks.en: VII Conclusion and Limitations
blocks.zh: 七. 结论和限制

blocks.en: We present Pixel-UMI, a pipeline for learning whole-body mobile manipulation from sensorized human demonstrations. Our results highlight the value of absolute joint-space actions for preserving body configurations that head and end-effector targets leave unspecified, and of environment geometry for determining those configurations. Together with calibrated action assignment and REAM, this approach supports challenging mobile and dexterous manipulation, achieving 87.0% average task progress across five tasks. For contact-rich tasks, on-policy corrections progressively extend the stages the policy can complete, increasing average task progress from 6.82% to 79.77% over two rounds. These findings demonstrate how human demonstrations can provide useful whole-body motion supervision and a starting point for further improvement through robot interaction.
blocks.zh: 我们介绍Pixel-UMI,一个从感官化的人类演示中学习全身移动操纵的管道. 我们的成果突出了绝对联合空间行动对于保留头部和最终效果目标未指明的体型以及环境几何对确定这些配置的价值。 这一方法与经过校准的行动任务和REAM一起,支持具有挑战性的移动和狡猾的操纵,在五个任务中实现了87.0%的平均任务进度. 对于接触量大的任务,政策方面的纠正措施将逐步延长政策可以完成的阶段,使两轮的平均任务进度从6.82%增加到79.77%。 这些研究结果表明人类的演示如何能够提供有用的全身运动监督,并通过机器人互动来作为进一步改进的起点.

blocks.en: Several limitations remain. Delay-calibrated action assignment provides approximate command labels but cannot recover the contact-dependent actions underlying demonstrated motion. In particular, motion alone does not reveal the forces applied when contact prevents further movement. Force/torque or tactile sensing, combined with robot dynamics and controller models, could improve action inference and reduce reliance on corrective robot data.
blocks.zh: 仍然存在若干限制。 延迟校准动作任务提供了近似命令标签,但无法恢复所显示的运动背后的依赖接触的动作. 特别是,单凭运动并不能揭示在接触阻碍进一步行动时所运用的力量。 强迫/触觉感知,结合机器人动力学和控制模型,可以改进动作推论,减少对矫正机器人数据的依赖.

blocks.en: Retargeting quality also depends on the reconstructed environment. Our reconstruction uses a single head-mounted depth camera, leaving occluded or unobserved surfaces incomplete; additional viewpoints and sensors could improve coverage and accuracy. The static-scene formulation further limits how moving obstacles and intended contacts are represented. Finally, although retargeting generates whole-body trajectories, the demonstrated motion targets specify only the head and grippers. Intentional contacts involving other body parts, such as using an elbow to hold a door open or a hip to close a drawer, are therefore not explicitly captured. Supporting these behaviors would require richer body-motion or contact supervision and retargeting objectives that account for the intended interactions.
blocks.zh: 重新确定质量目标还取决于重建的环境。 我们的重建使用单台头架深度照相机,使闭合或无法观察的表面不完整;额外的视线和传感器可以提高覆盖面和准确性。 静电场的表述进一步限制了移动障碍和预期接触的体现方式。 最后,虽然重新瞄准生成全身的轨迹,但演示的运动目标只指定头部和抓手. 因此,没有明确记录涉及其他身体部位的有意接触,例如使用肘部把门打开或臀部关上抽屉。 支持这些行为需要更丰富的身体运动或接触监督,并重新确定目标,以考虑到预期的相互作用。
